author: codex-ai-model-pilot
first_raw_notes: Nubes extensas en muelles y patios. Sectores de canal y fondeo requieren inspección de máscaras.
coordinate_convention: Half-open pixel-edge boxes; WGS84 vertices are exact transforms, not a claim of subpixel annotation accuracy. Hull dimensions and family are unknown.
method: Viewed the four registered raw previews and masks. Enlarged every area proposed for review, including open-water strips, port structures, and individual vessel windows.
Fixed visual reference boxes, review scope, unknown regions and cloud-mask disagreements without querying model detections or scores.
Original quality rasters and registered images remain unchanged; local visual extensions are explicit and require second review.
A cloudy observation is an abstention, not zero vessels. Absence applies only to the stated reviewed negative area.
These reference objects must be matched/adjudicated before importing: empty existing_detections/additions arrays do not mean empty labels. No model performance is assessed.

limitations: AI first review; references are proposals until independent adjudication.
One target acquisition per report; multiple zones are not independent passes.
10 m imagery does not establish absence of small vessels or separate every quayside object.
All type, length and width fields remain null.
Calibration references are not test results and do not establish detection precision.

consolidation_notes: Las decisiones y altas enumeran todas las propuestas leídas y todas las referencias raw del ámbito explícito.
Requiere segunda revisión independiente y adjudicación antes de aplicar; no se modificó la base de datos.
Las cajas de referencia son idénticas al informe raw fijado antes de consultar propuestas. Cambios de ámbito de segunda revisión se enumeran explícitamente.
No se calculó precisión, recall, IoU ni calibración. Correspondencia administrativa no es evaluación científica.
Ámbito null es abstención; sus listas vacías no constituyen ausencia de buques.
